jobs.description: Our vision is to become a leading specialist in staffing services and, through our values, create effective solutions and secure conditions at every stage. Our values are Safety, Engagement, Closeness, and Quality.Eterni has unique expertise and experience in delivering flexible staffing solutions to industries impacted by seasonal fluctuations and a general shortage of qualified labor. In addition to attracting local talent, Eterni also has solid experience in recruiting from abroad.We work every day to be actively involved in each other’s working lives, and through our presence, we aim to foster equality and an inclusive work environment. Eterni provides innovative, competent, and sustainable solutions for both our employees and our customers.We are seeking an experienced Tinsmith with a minimum of 5 years’ experience in the construction industry. In this role, you will be responsible for a wide range of sheet-metal and roofing tasks, from installation to maintenance and repair.Key Responsibilities:- Perform sheet-metal and roofing tasks, including roof installation and repair.- Weld thermoplastic membranes.- Process sheet metal for various applications.- Install and repair facades, downspouts, and gutters.- Carry out additional sheet-metal and roofing duties as required.- Min. 5 years’ of work experience in the construction industry as a construction sheet-metal worker or roofer.- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.- Familiarity with operating construction tools and equipment, with particular emphasis on sheet-metal and roofing machinery.- Good communication skills in English and/or NorwegianAdditional information: Assistance in finding accommodation and support from an HR-consultant is possible
